Container.Name: Net-Eboks
Container.Overview:
POP3 proxy for e-Boks (eboks.dk), the Danish national digital mail system. Allows you to read your e-Boks messages via any standard POP3 mail client. Authentication is done via MitID.
SETUP (one-time, per user): 1. Run with EBOKS_MODE=auth and --network=host to complete MitID authentication. Open http://localhost:9999/ in a browser with CORS disabled (see README). 2. After authentication, restart with EBOKS_MODE=pop3 (the default). 3. Connect your mail client to this host on port 8110. Username: CPR number (e.g. 123456-7890), Password: e-Boks mobile password.
NOTE: This is a work in progress. See the project README for full details.

Config.Name: POP3 Port
Config.Description: POP3 proxy port. Connect your mail client here. Username is CPR (e.g. 123456-7890), password is your e-Boks mobile password.

Config.Name: Auth Web UI Port
Config.Description: MitID authentication web UI port. Only used when EBOKS_MODE=auth. Requires host networking or local browser access.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Service mode: 'pop3' runs the POP3 proxy (normal operation), 'auth' runs the one-time MitID authentication setup wizard.

Config.Name: POP3 Listen Address
Config.Description: Address for the POP3 server to listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from all interfaces (default for Docker).

Config.Name: POP3 Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal POP3 port inside the container. Change only if you have a reason to.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable verbose debug output in container logs.
